Hi everyone!

We've been circling on Project Gingham for a few weeks now and I think we're finaly ready to land it. I'd love for us to walk out of this room with a direction everyone can stand behind — there are some real tradeoffs between the options and I want to hear where each of you lands, espcially on what it means for night shift and for the step-down unit.

Nico and Arjun, you'll be the ones living with whatever we pick operationally, so please come ready to push back if something won't work on the floor.

I'll circulate the comparison sheet the day before. Coffee and pastries on me!!

Can't wait!!
Nadia"}]}
